name: RadAway: Diluted
blurb: How to obtain RadAway: Diluted — crafting recipe, ingredients, vendors and any world sources. Directions and photos are added by hand.

creatures.note: Around 1,958 creatures can drop RadAway: Diluted as generic loot; they are not listed individually. See the Containers expand for the per-container drop rates and How to Obtain for the crafting recipe.

consumption.note: RadAway: Diluted is a chem consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
